items.heading: Most Law Students Ask This
items.text: Most law students ask this question backwards. They ask "which certificate course looks the best," when the real question is "which specific gap in my resume is actually stopping me from getting the work I want." An LLB alone tells a recruiter you studied law. It does not tell them you can draft a clean indemnity clause, structure a due-diligence checklist, or explain the DPDP Act to a client in plain language.

items.heading: The Legal World Is Not
items.text: The legal world is not one job. It is drafting, research, contracts, compliance, litigation support, policy, regulation tracking, and client coordination, each with a genuinely different daily task mix.

items.heading: These Are Real, Currently Listed
items.text: These are real, currently listed programs from Indian law universities and law-focused institutes - verify current fees, dates, and eligibility directly on each institute's own admissions page before applying, since intake windows and fees change.
